notes: JavaScript-Rendered Content Detected: The initial HTML from fetch_page shows only WordPress theme structure (Colibri theme) with header/navigation and footer elements. No business listing content is present in the static HTML. The page likely uses one of the following: 1) Embedded iframe from a third-party listing service, 2) AJAX/API calls to load listings after page load, 3) JavaScript framework rendering. RECOMMENDATION: Requires browser automation (Playwright/Selenium) to render JavaScript and capture the actual listing elements. Once rendered, inspect the page to identify: container selector for individual listings, selectors for title/price/location/URL fields. Alternative: Check browser network tab for API endpoints that might be called to fetch listing data directly.
